evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep skips the time-boxed framing entirely. Opens with 'This is a good contact number' without ever saying 'this will take 10-15 minutes' or 'you can walk away with a quote you can depend on' or waiting for a yes.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after probing has started: 'Besides and pricing, do you have any questions or concerns you would like answered on this call today?' — but this comes after the rep has already confirmed the booking date and is well into Section 1 discovery.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: All four covered: name (Jay), moving day (October 26th), route (from Humble TX to Houston TX), and size (~800 sq ft). Walkthrough not applicable — under 1,800 sq ft.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floors/stories (third floor to second floor), rooms (one bedroom, implied total size 800 sq ft), walking distance (stair access mentioned twice), special considerations (sectional sofa, king bed, tempered glass table, 65" TV), additional stops (gated complex noted). All seven items covered or clearly discussed.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Never asked. Rep mentions wrapping and shrink wrap in context of customer's own prep, but does not offer 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked. No mention of typical box count or overflow check.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Partial. Rep gives a time range ('between 3:00 and four probably more... maybe even three and a half') but does not anchor it to a typical estimate for an 800 sq ft apartment or personalize it to this customer's move beyond time estimate. No dollar amount given.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Rep covers: hourly rate structure, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments after minimum, 'everything is included' (fuel, trucks, taxes, insurance, wrapping, pads, bands, tools for disassembly/reassembly). Fee transparency present without the customer asking.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or any version of it. Moves directly to 'Do you have any other questions for me today.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Not mentioned. No reference to on-time guarantee or any discount terms.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Partial. Rep states 'we have our no worries, damage coverage. Which is our free evaluation coverage included in the hourly rate, provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse app, proximal damages.' Mentions $2,000 and that it's included, but does not explicitly frame the 'no deductible / no fine print' language.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirm that the two promises have addressed customer concerns. Moves directly to asking if there are other questions.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep asks 'Do you have any other questions for me today?' which is a generic throwaway, not 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any explicit close. The call ends with confirmation that the customer already has an online booking for October 26th, and the rep says 'we look forward to seeing you on the twenty sixth' — implying the booking is already done, not asking for the business.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No reference to rate lock or deposit policy.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (October 26th), phone number (763-245-3509), addresses (from/to), floor levels, apartment numbers (303 origin, 0522 destination — customer corrects this mid-call), crew-relevant notes (gated complex, blue building with whitish gray brick, corner landmark, parking logistics at new complex unclear). Missing: explicit arrival window confirmation, crew size not discussed, no notes left for crew about what customer was worried about.

top_strength: Brianne gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, floors, special items, exact addresses with landmark notes) and disclosed pricing structure transparently without the customer having to ask.
coaching_note: Never delivered the foundational quid pro quo / time-box framing in Section 1, skipped the explicit ask for the business in Section 7 (treated the pre-existing booking as a close instead of re-confirming), and missed both promises sections (no On-Time Guarantee at all, and damage coverage was incomplete) — these are load-bearing structural gaps that undermine the call flow.
